title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Get Stronger by Staying Exposed
caption:
The strongest thing you do this week might be the thing that feels like exposure.

Not a testimony from the stage. Not a post. Just telling two guys the real number, the real week, the real thing you've been rehearsing and not sending.

What you hide grows. What you confess starts to die.

Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed (James 5:16). Not just repent to God in private. Say it to a man who'll ask about it again next week.

Pick one from this list. Send the text tonight.
